scope.target: Desktop studio: macOS, Windows and Linux qualification; compact laptop layout included.
scope.delivery: 28 editable screens/states and selected click-through interactions.
scope.originalScope: The original 116 requirement groups and 30 work packages remain in force.
scope.decisionRefinement: Original D08 had no Figma source. This task adds this file as the v1 design source; it does not supersede engine ownership or release/licensing gates.

foundations.fontDecision: New design uses Inter for controls, Space Grotesk for workspace/project titles and IBM Plex Mono for time/numerals. Existing source uses an OS system stack; this is an explicit redesign proposal, not source parity.

principles: The music is the main surface; never gate manual editing behind AI.
One persistent transport and one visible edit target.
Compose, Arrange, Mix, Perform and Visuals are workspace lenses on one project.
AI results are revision-scoped, auditionable proposals with partial accept, reject and undo.
Record and performance actions are explicit, armed and reversible where possible.
Busy/unsupported states explain the blocked action and preserve independent work.
Static/imported and generated media share the same editing and asset lifecycle.
Minimize panels through context; keep deep tools discoverable.
architectureConstraints: Tracktion/JUCE owns the musical Edit and audio clock.
Rust coordinates project identity, jobs, checkpoints, permissions and history.
React keeps bounded viewport projections and transient interactions, never PCM/tensors or a second mutable song graph.
Figma demo data is not production audio, meter or model evidence.

compact.policy: Close secondary panels into drawers; retain working typography, transport and contextual bottom editor.

responsive.implementationPolicy: Make geometry fluid between references; do not hardcode every screen to these canvas sizes. Below 1280 define and test a minimum size or an accessible panel strategy; do not merely shrink the page.
responsive.textZoom: Implement and test 200% text scaling/reflow; not verified by the Figma prototype.

rules: No preview notes in the durable musical graph.
Every accept uses projectId, target IDs, expectedRevision and commandId.
Commit only accepted note IDs and acknowledge the revision.
Stale output is rejected; refresh is an explicit action.
Discard after partial acceptance removes remaining ghosts, not committed notes.
Undo only reverts the corresponding accepted transaction.
Permission denied or missing input produces a visible reason.
Stop flushes/preserves the take before review.
No device reconfiguration or updater restart while recording.
A queue acknowledgement is not a play acknowledgement.
All-notes-off remains an explicit safety action.
Saved means a verified durable checkpoint was published.
Never overwrite the last good checkpoint with incomplete staging data.
Cancel/failed save never discards the in-memory song.
AI never sends direct unreviewed fixture or device commands.
Visual/AI work never blocks the audio callback.

prototype.limitation: Selected state transitions only. Export, audition, recording and generation are simulated by navigation; physical audio/video and arbitrary editing are not implemented.

acceptanceTests.title: First empty project
acceptanceTests.action: Create a blank project from home.
acceptanceTests.expected: Show no seeded notes, tracks or assets; choose a first action. No mandatory account/model download.

acceptanceTests.title: Workspace continuity
acceptanceTests.action: Select a region and change workspaces repeatedly.
acceptanceTests.expected: Stable selection, musical time, history and viewport restoration; no second project loaded.

acceptanceTests.title: Theme and sizing
acceptanceTests.action: Exercise 1600×1000 and 1280×832 in both themes.
acceptanceTests.expected: No clipped actionable controls; secondary panels collapse; semantic fills and readable labels in both modes.

acceptanceTests.title: Text zoom
acceptanceTests.action: Use 200% text scaling with keyboard navigation.
acceptanceTests.expected: Reflow or intentional scroll retains controls and focus; no whole-screen bitmap scaling.

acceptanceTests.title: Knob and fader
acceptanceTests.action: Drag, fine-adjust, type values, press arrows, reset and undo.
acceptanceTests.expected: Displayed units, handle, parameter and engine agree; values bounded; one drag produces one undo transaction.

acceptanceTests.title: Command retry
acceptanceTests.action: Replay the same edit commandId after a dropped acknowledgement.
acceptanceTests.expected: No duplicate note/clip; reconcile the acknowledged revision.

acceptanceTests.title: Native time mapping
acceptanceTests.action: Test tempo changes, zooming, off-grid notes, loop edges and sample boundaries.
acceptanceTests.expected: UI geometry maps through the shared native time contract, not independent JS timers.

acceptanceTests.title: Keyboard and text
acceptanceTests.action: Type a space, shortcuts and IME composition inside fields; then exit.
acceptanceTests.expected: No unwanted transport start. Editor shortcuts resume only in the appropriate context.

acceptanceTests.title: Input permission denial
acceptanceTests.action: Deny microphone permission or remove the selected device.
acceptanceTests.expected: Explain the blocker without a fake meter or recording state; allow configuration or a manual MIDI path.

acceptanceTests.title: Record preservation
acceptanceTests.action: Record, stop, review, cancel comp and reopen project.
acceptanceTests.expected: Original take stays available; flush errors surfaced; review only after retained output is ready.

acceptanceTests.title: Nondestructive comp
acceptanceTests.action: Choose three phrases from four takes, commit and undo.
acceptanceTests.expected: Comp changes are reversible; source asset bytes remain unchanged.

acceptanceTests.title: Ghost preview and audition
acceptanceTests.action: Request notes, audition and stop without accepting.
acceptanceTests.expected: No durable musical edit or auto-insert; preview bus stops cleanly and original remains unchanged.

acceptanceTests.title: Partial acceptance
acceptanceTests.action: Accept four selected notes, then accept the remaining four.
acceptanceTests.expected: Only selected IDs commit each time; two acknowledged transactions; ghosts separated from notes.

acceptanceTests.title: Partial undo and discard
acceptanceTests.action: Undo the last accepted subset; alternatively discard remaining ghosts.
acceptanceTests.expected: Undo restores accepted subset only; discard never deletes already committed notes.

acceptanceTests.title: Stale response
acceptanceTests.action: Change the song while the suggestion is generating.
acceptanceTests.expected: Reject old expectedRevision; disable acceptance; refresh explicitly; no silent rebase.

acceptanceTests.title: Invalid output
acceptanceTests.action: Return malformed notes, unknown IDs, out-of-range velocities or nonfinite time.
acceptanceTests.expected: Typed validation refuses the proposal before engine mutation and preserves the project.

acceptanceTests.title: Gesture safety
acceptanceTests.action: Draw with pointer capture, lose focus, cancel, reconnect and commit.
acceptanceTests.expected: Held notes release on loss; preview discarded on cancel; committed notes remain editable.

acceptanceTests.title: Gesture alternatives
acceptanceTests.action: Use piano roll/keyboard without camera or continuous movement.
acceptanceTests.expected: Equivalent conventional composition remains available; camera consent is never forced.

acceptanceTests.title: Generation failure
acceptanceTests.action: Cancel, exhaust memory or kill a worker mid-job.
acceptanceTests.expected: Song unchanged; job state accurate; partial assets quarantined/cleaned; no automatic cloud fallback.

acceptanceTests.title: Asset acceptance
acceptanceTests.action: Accept a generated result, move source folder and reopen.
acceptanceTests.expected: Imported immutable asset has provenance and availability state; media not an ephemeral URL.

acceptanceTests.title: Scene timing
acceptanceTests.action: Queue a scene just before and just after a bar boundary.
acceptanceTests.expected: Queued is visible until native launch; explicit sceneId/trackId membership; no prefix inference.

acceptanceTests.title: Live safety
acceptanceTests.action: Trigger all-notes-off or stop all clips while optional workers are busy.
acceptanceTests.expected: Native action remains responsive; state acknowledgement visible; no AI permission gate on panic.

acceptanceTests.title: Preview and program
acceptanceTests.action: Open visuals and generate a candidate with an external display connected.
acceptanceTests.expected: Output remains disarmed until explicit arm; preview never unexpectedly goes live.

acceptanceTests.title: Visual failure
acceptanceTests.action: Kill renderer or overload GPU during playback.
acceptanceTests.expected: Expose preview/output failure; native audio does not wait for frames; blackout/fallback is visible.

acceptanceTests.title: Missing plugin
acceptanceTests.action: Reopen with an unavailable or quarantined plugin.
acceptanceTests.expected: Saved state and routing retained; locate/replace/bypass explicit; no silent substitute.

acceptanceTests.title: Engine exit
acceptanceTests.action: Terminate native engine or force a plugin crash on the in-process path.
acceptanceTests.expected: UI says audio stopped, offers verified recovery and restarts stopped; no uninterrupted-audio claim.

acceptanceTests.title: Failed checkpoint
acceptanceTests.action: Simulate no space, denied write or disappearing destination.
acceptanceTests.expected: Keep unsaved edits and last good checkpoint; header does not show Saved until durable verification.

acceptanceTests.title: Real export
acceptanceTests.action: Export a known fixture, including tails, then compare bytes/sample properties.
acceptanceTests.expected: Real render duration/format/channels correct; success only on verified file; no double dither.

acceptanceTests.title: Preflight failures
acceptanceTests.action: Disconnect routing, remove an asset and disable a plugin.
acceptanceTests.expected: Report actual missing dependencies and blocking conditions instead of hardcoded green checks.

acceptanceTests.title: Memory and repaint
acceptanceTests.action: Open large fixture, scroll/zoom and operate meters for a long session.
acceptanceTests.expected: Bounded viewport subscriptions, peak-level-of-detail and cache eviction; no raw PCM/tensors in WebView state.

acceptanceTests.title: Renderer reload
acceptanceTests.action: Reload presentation while native playback/recording is active.
acceptanceTests.expected: Test architecture behavior; engine never depends on a WebView timer; retain truthful health and reconciliation.

acceptanceTests.title: Least privilege
acceptanceTests.action: Attempt worker path escape, unapproved upload and unauthorized device command.
acceptanceTests.expected: Controller rejects requests; no ambient filesystem/network/camera rights; redact diagnostics.

acceptanceTests.title: Accessibility
acceptanceTests.action: Screen-reader and keyboard-test controls, selection and errors.
acceptanceTests.expected: Names, units, focus and noncolor state cues; grids expose manageable visible subsets and meaningful navigation.

acceptanceTests.title: Score mapping
acceptanceTests.action: Change display quantization and map selection back to the piano roll.
acceptanceTests.expected: Performance unchanged by engraving settings; stable note IDs; supported editing/export separately tested.

acceptanceTests.title: Native plugin window
acceptanceTests.action: Open, focus, resize and close a real VST3/AU editor on each supported OS.
acceptanceTests.expected: No fake web editor; native window ownership and focus shortcuts verified.

acceptanceTests.title: Update inhibition
acceptanceTests.action: Offer update during recording, performance or unsaved changes.
acceptanceTests.expected: No forced restart, install interruption or lost work; exact update policy enforced.
